44843.title: A Work Order number matches exactly with or without the dash or a space
44843.refs: SV-9160 (PRD 7 (S2-15276 = s215276); identifier fields are exact-only)
44843.custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to ShopView. In the app header, click the search field (or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K) to open the global search, which searches across work orders, customers, parts and more; results appear grouped by type under a tab strip.
1. A Work Order 'S2-15276' exists.
44843.custom_steps:
1. In the search box, type 'S2-15276' and read the result.
2. Clear the input and type 'S215276' (no dash) and read the result.
3. Clear the input and type 'S2 15276' (with a space) and read the result.
44843.custom_expected:
All three forms find the same Work Order 'S2-15276'.

The Work Order number is treated as an identifier: it is normalized by stripping the dash/space, so 'S2-15276' equals 's215276'.

The match is exact (identifier), not fuzzy.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9160 and the Global Search - Product Requirements specification version 1.5 (Confluence page 576978945), section 7 (S2-15276 = s215276); identifier fields are exact-only, read on 16 September 2026.

Last checked against build v26.36.7-21b4db9 on 9/16/2026.

44847.title: Typos in identifier fields do NOT return fuzzy matches
44847.refs: SV-9160 (PRD 7 (exact identifier fields bypass fuzzy logic))
44847.custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to ShopView. In the app header, click the search field (or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K) to open the global search, which searches across work orders, customers, parts and more; results appear grouped by type under a tab strip.
1. A Work Order 'S2-15276' exists and no Work Order 'S2-15286' exists.
44847.custom_steps:
1. In the search box, type a near-miss Work Order number, for example 'S2-15286' (one digit off from a real WO).
2. Read the result rows and the group headings in the results list.
44847.custom_expected:
The real Work Order 'S2-15276' is NOT returned as a fuzzy match.

Because identifier fields are exact-only, a one-digit-off WO number returns no fuzzy identifier match (it may show 'No results' if nothing else matches).

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9160 and the Global Search - Product Requirements specification version 1.5 (Confluence page 576978945), section 7 (exact identifier fields bypass fuzzy logic), read on 16 September 2026.

Last checked against build v26.36.7-21b4db9 on 9/16/2026.

44850.title: An exact identifier match is pinned as a single row at the very top
44850.custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to ShopView. In the app header, click the search field (or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K) to open the global search, which searches across work orders, customers, parts and more; results appear grouped by type under a tab strip.
1. A Work Order 'S2-15276' exists.
44850.custom_steps:
1. In the search box, type the exact Work Order number 'S2-15276'.
2. Look at the top of the results.
44850.custom_expected:
The exactly-matched Work Order is pinned as a single row at the very top, above the grouped results, labeled with its entity icon.

This gives the 'type the number, jump straight to it' experience.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9160 and the Global Search - Product Requirements specification version 1.5 (Confluence page 576978945), section 6.2 (an exact identifier match above 0.95 pinned at the top), read on 16 September 2026.

Last checked against build v26.36.7-21b4db9 on 9/16/2026.
